correctness.rationale: For n=3^r, the graph adjacency is [[c,1],[1,0]] over R=F_q[ε]/ε^n with c=2+ε²/(1+ε). Cayley–Hamilton gives Φ_5(T)=δ(T³+T), and T⁵−I=δ U for an explicitly proved invertible U. This implies for 5|k a kernel dimension 4min(n,2·3^ν₃(k/5)); for 5∤k the iterate has no nonzero fixed vector. Positivity at the final exponent proves exact order 5n and the nested period counts. Boundary n=3, arbitrary extension-field q=3^f, and all k>0 are treated. A pure-Python exact rank checker passed for n=3,9,27; an independently structured C++ exhaustive walk checked all 531441 states for n=3. Finite checks are corroborative, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A natural, standard graph operation (one private leaf per ring vertex) shifts the reversible characteristic-three wave from the bare-cycle 3n clock to an exact 5n clock and produces an entire infinite-family primitive-orbit census. The residue-field fifth-cyclotomic mechanism and ε² valuation provide structural explanation, not just an isolated table or mechanical parameter increment. The distinction from characteristic-two threefold clocks motivates the precise invariant and future characteristic-sensitive corona studies. No downstream theorem or independent certification is claimed.
